focus: Coloured operads, context-preserving typed composition, residual/effect laws, and bounded composition-order experiments

scope.seed_access: No seed or private evaluator material was read. Public protocol and workflow audit supplied task-type constraints. No seed solution, paid call, or private storage access occurred.
scope.novelty_claim: New proposed adaptations to this repository, not claims of literature-wide novelty. Typed substitution, algebraic effects, and experimental order comparisons have established precedents.
scope.implementation_boundary: All new adapters, laws, grammar, and experiments below are proposals. Current compilation yields Unadmitted candidate plans. LP, integer-sum, cochain, stabilizer, and finite certificate presets do not become arbitrary symbolic QM checkers by receiving one common seed.
scope.benchmark_isolation: The original UTF-8 seed remains a separate immutable input in every paid request; hash exact bytes before and after construction. No rewriting, normalization, omission, changed Hamiltonian convention, or substituted task. Online checks use only public predicates and submitted artifacts. Freeze all outputs before isolated trusted evaluation; no private scores, expected values, answer-bearing diagnostics, or key-selected hints return to a workflow.

primary_sources.title: David I. Spivak, The operad of wiring diagrams: formalizing a graphical language for databases, recursion, and plug-and-play circuits (2013)
primary_sources.relevance: Defines hierarchical wiring syntax through an operad and gives a relational algebra interpreting that syntax. Supports separating admissible interconnection from a particular semantic interpretation; it does not verify this repository's operation bodies. Paper PDF was opened.

primary_sources.title: Ohad Kammar and Gordon D. Plotkin, Algebraic Foundations for Effect-Dependent Optimisations (POPL 2012)
primary_sources.relevance: Derives transformation laws from type/effect semantics and distinguishes generally structural laws from laws requiring assumptions about effects. Motivates checking a specific law before eliminating, duplicating, or reordering workflow operations. Primary author-hosted paper was opened.

repository_evidence.observation: Distinguishes signature substitution, callable behavior, residual laws, and unsupported end-to-end QM certification.
Requires unchanged seed, private evaluator isolation, matched comparisons, and run-wide USD 0.10 reservations.
Records the NaN residual counterexample and limits of typed compilation; no repair is claimed here.
49 family designs; WF1-WF5 have public runner source, while WF6-WF49 remain family proposals with varying pilot evidence. No complete seed checker is established.
Candidate output is Unadmitted. Full port equality includes colour, schema reference/hash, and validator reference/hash. Fixed depth/node caps and effect/tool ceilings apply.
Rejects shared outputs, lowers a rooted single-consumer graph to an ordered tree, checks its entry boundary, and never admits or executes it.
Substitution checks an ordered slot; associativity witnesses compare computed signatures for one instance rather than arbitrary operation behavior.
Callable composition runs children in order and combines residuals. Colour equality alone places no runtime contract on Python values or hidden side effects.
Risk is converted to float without a finite-domain check; absorption uses max and tuple concatenation; discharge accepts strings rather than independently checking a witness.

common_budget_policy.formula: Reserve C_max = sum_s(I_s*p_in_s + O_s*p_out_s + F_s) + R <= USD 0.10 over the entire execution, including every branch and retry. O_s covers all billable reasoning and response tokens; I_s covers original seed, instructions, schemas, framing, and prior artifacts. Prices are USD/token.
common_budget_policy.conditional_example: The examples assume p_in <= 0.000001, p_out <= 0.000005, all fixed fees F_s=0, and R=0.01. These are admission thresholds, not observed prices. Refuse unknown fees, uncapped reasoning, unsupported token bounds, or a larger quote.
common_budget_policy.routing: Freeze current provider/model/tariff and actual input bounds before dispatch. Disable automatic fallback and retries. Timeouts keep full reservations. Paid evaluator cost must be separately budgeted and disclosed or included in the same ceiling. No paid campaign is authorized by this report.
common_budget_policy.receipts: Use the existing run-wide ledger and record exact request/output hashes, reservations, actual usage/charge, wall time, and summed provider time. All research here cost USD 0 in provider calls.
common_budget_policy.host_compute: Enumeration and finite contract fixtures use bounded local CPU with zero incremental provider cost. Any metered host service must be reserved. Per candidate, cap static checking at 5 seconds and 256 MiB; timeout means unknown, never accepted.

ideas.name: Context-indexed adapter diamonds

mathematical_basis.known_method: An operad supplies typed substitution; its algebra supplies the meaning of the composite. A matching interface is necessary but does not establish preservation of a task or proposition.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Index each port by immutable task, assumption-context, artifact, evidence-scope, and schema identities. An adapter must expose a preservation relation and a refusal branch. For two admitted routes from the same representation to the same target, compare the preserved requested-claim inventory and assumptions, not just serialized output equality. The commuting diagram is an obligation until a checker establishes it for the declared fragment.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: An edge requires equal full five-field native port contracts plus equal task/context indices. A bridge A:X->Y carries a checked relation P_A(x,y); composed preservation is P_A(x,y) and P_B(y,z). Without an implemented relation checker, append OPEN_BRIDGE and retain candidate-only status. No implicit coercion of numerical evidence into symbolic evidence.

assumptions: At most two explicit bridge routes, four bridges per route, and 24 claim identifiers; both routes retain the complete requested inventory.
Artifact mutation changes its hash and invalidates all artifact-bound receipts. Task and assumption hashes cannot be recomputed from rewritten prose to disguise a change.
New state types require reviewed schema/validator bindings under the current closed native colour vocabulary; naming a new colour is not an admitted extension.
ideas.hypothesis: Explicit context indices and checked bridges reduce invalid composition and stale-evidence acceptance compared with colour-only composition, while retaining all valid public controls and improving complete-answer quality at matched budgets.

stages.instruction: Freeze immutable seed, public inventory and adapter contracts; reject unresolved native mappings before any attempt to run them.
Return the requested response with explicit context and representation tags; do not assert host acceptance.
Run only implemented public bridge predicates on both routes. Detect dropped branches, changed assumptions, stale hashes and unsupported scope promotions; preserve refusals and open bridges.
Repair artifact-local interface failures from allowlisted public diagnostics, preserving the original seed and claim inventory. Unproved semantic bridges remain explicit.
Recompute bridge checks on current hashes, render bounded claim scopes, and freeze bytes before isolated evaluation.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same two-call envelope with only colour/schema checks and ordinary critique.
ablations: Full native ports without context indices
One route only; no diamond comparison
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Public fixtures deliberately change assumptions, remove exceptional branches, reuse stale receipts, and preserve valid alternative encodings. Report false accepts, false rejects, completeness and trusted final scores separately. Diamond agreement is not semantic adequacy.

ideas.falsification: One accepted context-changing bridge or unjustified evidence promotion falsifies the preservation implementation. The performance hypothesis fails if matched-budget final quality does not improve or valid-control refusal offsets the reduction in false acceptance.
risks: Both routes can share the same faulty parser or omission.
Interface overhead can displace useful mathematical reasoning.
One finite fixture panel cannot prove a universal translation theorem.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=14000, O_total<=4400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.014+0.022+0.010=USD 0.046 for the complete execution.

ideas.name: Law-carrying residual folds with replayable discharge

mathematical_basis.known_method: Program rewrites require laws for the effects that observations retain; associativity of syntax does not establish equality of effectful execution.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Use an append-only event word together with integer microusd cost, bounded integer diagnostic risk, and declared effect sets. Define accumulation as concatenation, exact addition, max, and union. Treat discharge as a checked event replay, not removal by matching a string. Keep chronological evidence separate from the currently open-obligation projection.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: For event words L and L', combine (L,c,r,E)*(L',c',r',E')=(LL',c+c',max(r,r'),E union E'); identity=(empty,0,0,empty), with c nonnegative integer and r in {0,...,100}. Refuse nonfinite, negative or out-of-domain values. The product is associative but generally noncommutative because logs retain order. A discharge event requires an earlier exact obligation ID/context/artifact hash and an independent public receipt; replay failure stays OPEN.

assumptions: At most 64 residual events and 24 obligation IDs per run; duplicate IDs are rejected.
The integer risk field is diagnostic, not an estimated probability or a correctness score.
Budget reservations and actual costs remain distinct; recomputing a fold never redispatches a paid operation.
ideas.hypothesis: A law-checked fold and evidence-bound discharge eliminate representation/order-dependent loss of obligations without increasing unsupported final certification or exceeding the matched two-call budget.

stages.instruction: Check all finite risk triples and bounded event-word controls for associativity/unit; include NaN, infinity, negative cost, duplicate IDs, forged discharge and stale-artifact controls. Tests establish only this finite implementation panel.
Produce the requested response with explicit open obligations and artifact-bound evidence references.
Check public artifacts and replay typed events in order; do not accept model-authored discharge strings as evidence.
Respond to the public residual frontier once, emitting new artifacts or retaining open obligations. Never delete historical events.
Validate new discharge receipts, invalidate stale dependencies, retain failures and freeze output before trusted scoring.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: The same draft/repair schedule with a plain unresolved-string list.
ablations: Finite integer risk and exact cost only
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Compare folds for both bracketings of the same ordered operation occurrences on public fixtures; check full traces and values, not scalar risk alone. A separate adversarial body fixture mutates hidden state to demonstrate why residual laws do not certify arbitrary callables.

ideas.falsification: Any admitted unequal bracketing for the declared product or unproved discharge closes an obligation falsifies the contract. Equal diagnostic scalars with different trace meanings do not count as success. Final-quality benefits must survive matched-budget scoring.
risks: Correct event accumulation does not prove checker adequacy or pure operation behavior.
A trace schema may omit a relevant side effect.
Associativity permits rebracketing a fixed order, not swapping dependent operations.
ideas.budget_formula: Two calls, zero retries: I_total<=13000, O_total<=4200. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.013+0.021+0.010=USD 0.044 for the complete execution.

ideas.name: Typed order squares for screen-and-rewrite interactions

mathematical_basis.known_method: Commutation is a separate property from associativity and requires a declared observation and noninterference assumptions. A failure to commute can be an experimental interaction rather than a type error.
mathematical_basis.proposed_adaptation: Compare A;B with B;A on the same frozen draft, where A adds public detector annotations and B is one bounded model rewrite that may consume current annotations. Both act on an indexed packet and both arms end with a common fresh A check. Different output distributions are allowed and measured; no equivalence is presumed.
mathematical_basis.composition_rule: Packet(seed_hash,context_hash,candidate_hash,annotations) is the shared state type. A returns annotations bound to candidate_hash. B preserves seed/context but replaces candidate_hash and invalidates every old annotation. Identity of public interfaces makes both orders candidates; artifact validity rules and frozen effects determine executability. Final A never consults private evaluation.

assumptions: One draft and two branch rewrites: three model calls total across the paired execution, no retries or model judge.
A is a deterministic frozen public detector with an independently specified control panel; B uses the same model/settings and cap in each arm.
Each branch has isolated mutable state and child ledger reservations; both share immutable draft bytes. The pair is one correlated block, not two independent replicates.
A;B;A and B;A;A have equal public check counts. Randomize actual arm dispatch order; stale annotations are never silently reused.
ideas.hypothesis: Providing public diagnostic annotations before a rewrite improves the subsequent complete response relative to checking only afterward; any improvement is an order interaction on this seed, not a universal commutation law or transfer result.

stages.instruction: Freeze A/B interfaces, controls, budgets, effect declarations and dispatch randomization. Reserve both arms before starting.
Answer the unchanged seed; emit a bounded draft without private feedback.
Snapshot draft; run A before B only in AB. Use a neutral, explicitly diagnostic-free input in BA; record actual framing token counts.
Rewrite using current public annotations; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Rewrite using the frozen draft with no detector diagnosis supplied; preserve seed/context and emit new candidate bytes.
Run A once after AB and twice after BA, yielding two check occurrences per arm overall. Freeze both outputs, including refusals or truncations, with no score-based selection or repair.

baseline_and_ablations.baseline: Same-model direct answer at matched total dollars/tokens, reported separately from the paired order contrast.
ablations: Replace A with a preregistered irrelevant public control detector
Pure deterministic A/B fixture pair expected to commute; no paid calls
baseline_and_ablations.evaluation: Trusted evaluator scores both frozen answers independently after the pair ends. Across repeated independently generated drafts, randomize arm order and report raw paired differences, false rejections, completeness, cost and latency. Shared-prefix dependence must remain in uncertainty calculations; one item supports only within-item conclusions.

ideas.falsification: The claimed benefit fails if AB has no preregistered meaningful gain over BA at matched bounds, harms completeness, or depends on answer-bearing hints. Any stale annotation accepted after rewriting is a contract failure regardless of score.
risks: A's errors can anchor B; finite calibration is not semantic completeness.
Different prompt contents alter tokenization and can confound an unbalanced comparison.
The paired fork is a proposed external executor feature: the current native compiler forbids shared output nodes.
ideas.budget_formula: Entire paired execution, not per branch: three calls, I_total<=18000, O_total<=5400. At the conditional common thresholds, C_max<=0.018+0.027+0.010=USD 0.055; zero retries and zero paid judge calls.

recommended_reusable_primitive.name: Pinned typed adapter descriptor
recommended_reusable_primitive.definition: One record binds family/source/operation IDs, exact ordered full port contracts, immutable-context indices, implemented adapter entry point, preservation predicates, effect/read/write declarations, residual law versions, resource envelope, refusal behavior and status. It separates a research idea, a type-checkable candidate and a runnable configuration.

finite_composition_grammar.claim: Exhaustive only relative to a frozen finite descriptor registry, parameter grid, bridges, bounds and declared equivalence relation. No enumeration was executed here. Neither 49! arbitrary permutations nor every mathematically meaningful composition is claimed.
finite_composition_grammar.registry: Include exactly one audited descriptor per WF1..WF49 plus R04-I01..03; append the other research reports' ideas only after their finite descriptors are frozen. Retain each of the 46 existing variations as a separate finite parameter choice if desired, never an unbounded free-text knob. A family macro remains opaque until its own stages and finite cost bounds are pinned; it is not a generic solver.

state_types.RunContext: Exact SeedBytes plus task/context hashes, fixed claim inventory, public-only inputs, optional provenance-bound prior outcome, and one budget ledger ID.
state_types.Outcome: Candidate/refusal/failure sum type with exact answer bytes, public receipts, residuals, cost and provenance; contains no implicit correctness assertion.
state_types.Packet: RunContext plus candidate hash and artifact-bound annotations, used inside stage adapters.
state_types.CampaignSpec: Finite ordered run configurations, randomization, replicate count, stopping rule and explicitly authorized aggregate campaign ceiling.
state_types.CampaignReceipt: Frozen run outcomes and accounting; post-freeze private scores occupy a separate evaluator-only type with no outgoing workflow edges.
state_types.DetectorTask: Public detector specification and independent positive/negative fixtures; no private seed key.
state_types.DetectorSuite: Versioned predicates with finite calibration results and unsupported classes.
state_types.TranslationTask: Source artifact, target representation contract, task-preservation relation and scope.
state_types.CrosswalkReceipt: Translated artifact plus preservation evidence or explicit open bridge.
state_types.ResearchSpec: Finite hypotheses, admissible public witnesses and stopping criteria.
state_types.ResearchRecord: Frozen evidence and open obligations; no automatic solver adapter.
state_types.TransferDataset: Declared disjoint development and held-out task families, not repeated samples of one seed.
state_types.TransferRuleReceipt: Rules, lineage and measured split scope; cannot feed this benchmark's private scores back to solvers.
state_types.RewriteTask: Artifact, protected seed/context, explicit preservation predicate and finite mutation menu.
state_types.RewriteReceipt: New artifact with old/new hashes, preservation result and stale-receipt invalidation.
state_types.CustodyTask: Public manifests, hashes and provenance boundaries.
state_types.CustodyReceipt: Checked custody facts, missing evidence and failures; no mathematical correctness upgrade.
state_types.CheckerTask: Public checker contract and independently supplied mutation/control panel.
state_types.CheckerCandidate: Unadmitted checker implementation and bounded mutation results.
state_types.ClaimTask: Candidate claims, exact contexts and available public evidence.
state_types.AuthorityTask: Candidate receipts and explicit authority policy.
state_types.LeakAuditTask: Public feedback schema, allowed information flow and public probes.
state_types.GateReceipt: Pass/refuse/unknown with policy/version/candidate hashes; does not certify the underlying answer.
state_types.LawAuditTask: Finite typed operations, residual domain and explicit law registry.
state_types.LawReceipt: Finite counterexamples/passes with exact domain scope.
state_types.OrderPairSpec: RunContext plus two full Packet->Packet stage contracts and fixed paired schedule.
state_types.OutcomePair: Two distinct frozen outcomes under one aggregate budget; no best-score selector.

proposed_family_external_signatures.qualification: Proposed whole-run envelopes, not current native ports. Each original task restriction remains; unsupported QM presets are rejected rather than coerced.
Campaign/meta operations are not single-seed solver stages. WF31/WF37 additionally require appropriate hidden/transfer datasets.
Calibration must be independent of private answer-key feedback.
Internal adapter/law gates remain explicit nodes when lowering.
Candidate requires an external branch executor or two separately compiled arm trees; no native fan-out claim.

required_bridges: Outcome -> RunContext: explicit re-proposal bridge retaining original seed/context/claims, exact prior-outcome provenance, one shared ledger, and one consumed repair/re-entry fuel unit; refuses evaluator-derived content.
Outcome -> ClaimTask/TranslationTask/RewriteTask: separate named constructors with frozen public target contracts; receipts are side evidence and cannot silently replace the answer.
Outcome -> AuthorityTask and Outcome -> LeakAuditTask: explicit public policy/probe constructors; GateReceipt cannot cast to mathematically correct Outcome.
DetectorSuite plus Outcome -> Packet: a declared ordered binary annotation adapter preserves candidate bytes and calibration scope; applying it is not a completeness proof.
CrosswalkReceipt or RewriteReceipt -> Packet: requires successful preservation check and current artifact/context hashes; otherwise returns refusal/open obligation.
Finite list of run plans -> CampaignSpec: packaging only; execution requires a separate aggregate campaign authorization and cannot be smuggled under one per-run cap.

CheckerCandidate -> registered checker: no automatic edge; independent soundness/adequacy review and runtime admission are required. TransferDataset/ResearchSpec have no conversion from one seed that fabricates held-out evidence.

Immutable snapshot -> two branch inputs: external read-only copy bridge only. The existing single-output compiler cannot express a shared producer; compile arm trees separately and account the prefix once in the external ledger, or label the pair non-runnable.
syntax: T[X,0] ::= input_X, drawn from the finite preregistered external input slots.
T[Y,n] ::= op(T[X1,n1],...,T[Xk,nk]) when op:(X1,...,Xk)->Y is a frozen descriptor, k<=4, and n=1+sum(ni)<=16. Nullary constants are limited to finite frozen public configuration objects.

A composition candidate is a typed ordered tree with 2..6 nonadministrative macro occurrences, at least two distinct family/idea IDs, and at least one actual producer-consumer edge. Bridges count toward node/depth bounds. Mere juxtaposition, identity insertion, and pure administrative permutations are excluded.

Repeat/repair is not a grammar constructor. Expand at most one retry/repair per macro and at most two re-entry steps globally using decreasing integer fuel; every expanded stage consumes nodes, tokens and money.
For a fixed tree, enumerate only topological execution schedules of its explicit dependency/effect graph; never permute ordered input slots without a separately registered symmetry law.
finite_composition_grammar.enumeration: Dynamic-program over output type, exact node count, depth, fuel and cost envelope. Instantiate the finite parameter choices and ordered child partitions, then check indices/effects/preservation and canonicalize. Enumerate schedules by finite topological sorts. Record generated, rejected, unknown and deduplicated counts with reasons; stream the complete finite space or report partial traversal honestly. A heuristic shortlist cannot be labeled exhaustive.
admissibility: Every descriptor has concrete input/output schema and validator hashes, immutable task/context indices, source pins, resource upper bounds and typed refusal paths. The external signature table is a specification proposal, not evidence these bindings exist.

Native lowering respects the existing closed colour vocabulary, exact full port equality, source/capability ceilings, acyclicity, root reachability, ordered open inputs and single-consumer outputs. Missing schema/validator/executor bindings remain signature_pending or candidate_only.

No unknown provider cost, unchecked role count, unbounded loops, implicit paid retries, private evaluator input, changed task assumptions, hidden answer computation, or seed truncation. Missing task applicability is a refusal, not a new checker.

Any mutation invalidates artifact-specific receipts. Every claimed preservation or effect law needs its declared evidence; diagnostic agreement and scalar equality cannot discharge semantic obligations.

Same-seed experiments cannot supply new held-out task families. WF30 constraint changes are excluded from unchanged-seed arms unless they provably preserve the full original task; otherwise they are separately labeled benchmarks.
equivalence_dedup: Canonicalize occurrence IDs by ordered-tree position, JSON field order and exact source/parameter pins. Remove only declared pure administrative identities. Keep every real model-call occurrence distinct, including identical prompts, because stochastic draws and costs differ.

Quotient different syntax bracketings only when they denote the same ordered expanded occurrence tree and the relevant effect/residual law version is admitted. Otherwise retain both as law-audit candidates.

Swap adjacent independent deterministic host steps only with disjoint read/write sets and a checked commutation law preserving values, residuals, cost and observed trace modulo that specific law. Dependence tests alone do not establish commutation.

Do not merge screen-before-rewrite with rewrite-before-screen, different prompt order, different seeds/settings, different checker scopes, different refusal behavior, or different branch schedules merely because types or scalar diagnostics match.
statuses: descriptor_proposed: finite specification with missing implementation or schema bindings
typed_candidate: static declared interfaces and budget envelope compose; no execution or semantic admission inferred
compiled_unadmitted: existing compiler returns a candidate with pinned sources; still not executable admission

runnable_public_only: separately verified adapters/executor/checkers, public fixtures, immutable seed path, supported billing bounds and shared ledger are all installed; mathematical scope remains explicit
evaluated_frozen_seed: actually run, frozen and independently scored with complete accounting; success and failure outcomes retained
rejected or unresolved: preserve exact failed obligations; not silently removed from enumeration accounting
finite_composition_grammar.current_availability: This report supplies descriptors only. It implements no bridges, grammar enumerator, executor, checker or provider adapter. Existing WF1-WF5 runner source is not evidence that the proposed combined QM workflow is runnable. All three research ideas remain proposed_not_evaluated.
